 (BY MS. VINITA DWIVEDI - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for orders this day, 
 following:
 ORDER
This is a petition under section 482 Cr.P.C. for a direction to release the amount which has been deposited by the accused persons before the trial court.
2. The applicants are investors of Benian Borking Pvt. Ltd., a stamp Business Marketing Company run by Mohanlal, Sanjay and Vinay Nagar.
All these three persons allured the applicants to invest money in their company with assurance of return of money with interest @ 1.5% per month.
Applicants individually invested a large sum of money in the said company between 23.9.2013 to 12.4.2016.
The said amount was not returned to the applicants and they lodged report to the police station for commission of offence under sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 IPC against those three persons.
During trial, this Court while granting bail to Mohanlal, incorporated a condition of deposit of Rs. 9 Lacs.

After the trial, the accused persons have been convicted for the offence under sections 420 r/w section 120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo Signing time: 20-Jun-23 5:33:51 RI for 5 years and fine of Rs.3 Lacs which is to be paid to the applicants after 60 days if no appeal is preferred.

Trial court also determined the fine of Rs.9 Lacs to be paid to the applicants as under :-
 S.No. Name Amount  1. Rahul Rs.3,50,000/-
 2. Madhubala Rs.50,000/-
 3. Jagdish Rs.50,000/-

 5. Deeprakash Rs.5,000/-
 6. Kamla Jain Rs.60,000/-
 7. Swati Pradhan Rs.1,05,000/-
 8. Pravin Pradhan Rs.1,05,000/-
 9. Satyanarayan Rs.1,05,000/-
 10. Rakesh Prajapat Rs.5,000/-
3.

Counsel for the applicants submits that accused persons have preferred the connected appeal and jail sentence of the appellants have been suspended, however the aforesaid deposited amount has not been disbursed to the applicants as per order of the trial court.
4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the para 21 of the order of the trial court, the present application is allowed.

Trial court is directed to disburse the amount to the applicants as mentioned in the above table subject to furnishing security to the satisfaction of the trial court and an undertaking that in case if the order passed by the trial court is set aside in the appeal, the said amount shall be deposited with the trial court along with interest.
With the aforesaid, M.Cr.C. is allowed and disposed of.
